name: Pakistan
blurb: Mughal Lahore and the high peaks of the Karakoram.
cities: Lahore
Mughal forts, mosques and a famous food street.
Hunza Valley
Apricot orchards beneath the Karakoram peaks.
Islamabad
A green capital below the Margalla Hills.
Skardu
The gateway to K2 and the Deosai plains.
Karachi
A seaside megacity of food streets and markets.
Mohenjo-daro
Brick streets, baths and granaries of a great Indus Valley city.
Takht-i-Bahi
A hilltop Buddhist monastery with Gandharan sculpture.
Makli Necropolis
One of the world's largest cemeteries, with carved and tiled tombs.
Rohtas Fort
A massive 16th-century fortress built by Sher Shah Suri.
Taxila
Gandharan Buddhist monasteries and the ruins of a city Alexander visited.
